title: Primavera 150 Tech (Dark Edition)
description: Representing Vespa's prowess in the Commuter Scooter class, the Vespa Primavera 150 Tech (Dark Edition) is delivers ultra-nimble urban agility for riders navigating congested city centers. A 150cc powerplant pumps out 16 HP and 13 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With an accessible 765mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights and a comfortable Step-Through Upright layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
